XMLDB.COMMENT: ADR-032 exams importer tests. NOT a copy of a BizLMS file: the BizLMS plugin local_onlineexams declares no table at all (BZ local/onlineexams/db has install.php, upgrade.php and uninstall.php, and no install.xml), and a BizLMS online exam is a course row with open_module online_exams. The one table here is local_onlinetests, which no BizLMS code defines or writes but which the Sentientia exam reader assumed (exam_manager.php, before ADR-032) and the mapping doc section 9 says preflight must block on when it exists with rows. Its shape is hand-written from what that reader selected (id, quizid, costcenterid, departmentid) plus the timestamps every BizLMS table carries. This deviates from the ADR-032 Test approach 2 rule that fixture copies are verbatim, because there is nothing to copy. Created once per test class by the legacy_schema_fixture trait and dropped afterwards.
